text:
marta: quick note — after the EU saturation incident, thinking about a simple runtime signal: 'detourable=true|false' that proxies can set early. keeps decision cheap.
omar: I like cheap signals. but need sensitivity + tenant opt-out. lucy: agree. also add model_stability tag to avoid downgrades for streamed sessions.
marta: proposal: X-Detourable: true/false, X-Sensitivity: low/high, X-Session-locked: true/false. router uses these at admission only.
lucy: ops concern: cold KV on detour spikes cost; add advise header X-Prewarm-Hint with top-3 prefixes.
infra-bot: launched 2% canary: detours=23, avg-latency +18ms, kv-miss +9%.
omar: next steps: small RFC addendum with headers and proxy fast-cache TTL=500ms. I'll draft.
marta: tagging legal for consent defaults and console folks for per-tenant toggle.
lucy: thanks — concise and actionable.
